question: For each academic year where both (1) there are subjects offered by departments in the 'Engineering' school during terms with a term status indicator of 'P', excluding subjects offered by the Chemistry department and only including courses with materials, and (2) the Mathematics department has subjects with enrollment greater than 10, provide the academic year, academic year description, the variance of the number of enrolled students in those Engineering subjects, the department name, the number of unique Mathematics subjects with enrollment greater than 10, and the minimum total units offered for those Mathematics subjects. List the results ordered by academic year descending and department name. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH eng AS (
  SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS t
  JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED tso ON t.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE
  WHERE t.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P'

    AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'
),

  SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.TOTAL_UNITS

),
valid_years AS (
  SELECT e.ACADEMIC_YEAR

  SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_enrolled

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH DeptReservedMaterials AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) > 10), ChemistrySubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT drm.department_name, drm.total_reserved_materials, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.max_enrolled_students FROM DeptReservedMaterials AS drm JOIN ChemistrySubjects AS cs ON drm.department_name = cs.join_dept_name ORDER BY drm.total_reserved_materials DESC, cs.max_enrolled_students DESC

WITH enrolled_variance_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE enrolled_students_variance > (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), material_count_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count_for_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, evc.enrolled_students_variance, mcc.highest_material_count_for_status FROM enrolled_variance_cte AS evc LEFT JOIN material_count_cte AS mcc ON evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY evc.enrolled_students_variance DESC
